RE: Proj. I 94-5 (45) 317; I.D. 1030-1-00 Proj. E 078-1 (47); I.D. 2015-1-00 Airport Spur I-94 to General Mitchell Field Milwaukee County
Dear Mr. Herried:
Milwaukee County has been an active participant in developing improved access to General Mitchell Field. Mitchell Field is an important air transportation hub, not only to the County, but to the entire State. As such, it is imperative that a more efficient and safer access route be developed to serve the needs of increasing air transportation demands.
The recommended alignment Alternate #5 offers the least disruptive connection to the Airport with minimal adverse environmental impacts. This alternate is also most compatible with long-range planning for the Airport.
The statement is well prepared and documented with respect to the assessment of impact to the environment.
Thanking you for the opportunity to offer comments on the Draft Environmental Impact Statement, and with kindest personal regards, I remain
Very truly yours,
(Val) &
John L. Doyne County Executive
